name: SeoVia – AI-Powered SEO Assistant for WordPress
author: SeoVia

sections.description:
SeoVia is an AI-powered SEO assistant for WordPress that helps you analyze, optimize, create, and manage website content from one central workspace.

It transforms SEO optimization from a repetitive, time-consuming process into a structured, automated, and measurable workflow.

Unlike traditional SEO plugins that mainly display scores and checklists, SeoVia helps perform the optimization work itself. It analyzes WordPress posts, pages, and WooCommerce products, identifies SEO weaknesses, and generates practical recommendations that can be reviewed and applied directly from the WordPress dashboard.

Recommendations may include:

  • Improved titles and content
  • Meta titles and descriptions
  • Internal linking opportunities
  • Structured data and Schema markup
  • Featured and in-content images
  • Categories and tags
  • FAQ sections
  • Tables and content blocks
  • New content opportunities

You can apply recommendations individually or in groups. Applied content changes can also be reverted when a previous version needs to be restored.

SeoVia integrates with Google Search Console to help identify keyword opportunities, content gaps, indexing issues, underperforming pages, and pages that are close to reaching stronger search positions.

For topics that are not yet covered by your website, SeoVia can guide you through creating a complete new article with optimized content, metadata, internal links, structured data, and relevant images.

SeoVia supports more than 30 AI models from major providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, and Stability AI. Available models and providers can be changed from the SeoVia service according to your preferences and account configuration.

The goal is simple: help website owners complete work that may normally require several SEO and content specialists, using a faster, more consistent, and measurable workflow.

Main Features

Intelligent SEO Dashboard

The SeoVia dashboard provides an overview of your website’s current SEO condition.

Depending on the available data, it can display metrics such as:

  • Average SEO score
  • Number of analyzed posts and pages
  • Indexed-page information
  • AI optimization status
  • Optimization progress over time

This helps you understand the general condition of the website without manually reviewing every page.

Analysis for Posts, Pages, and WooCommerce Products

SeoVia analyzes supported WordPress content and displays its current SEO status, optimization potential, and available recommendations.

You can quickly identify content that needs attention and review practical suggestions for improving it.

Supported content includes:

  • WordPress posts
  • WordPress pages
  • WooCommerce products

One-Click Apply and Revert

Recommendations can be applied individually or in groups.

When supported by the recommendation type, SeoVia stores the previous state so that applied changes can be reverted later.

This provides more control over optimization and reduces the risk of permanently applying an unwanted content change.

Smart Internal Linking

SeoVia evaluates the semantic relationship between your website’s content and suggests relevant internal links and anchor text.

It can help:

  • Connect related posts, pages, products, and categories
  • Discover internal-linking opportunities
  • Strengthen topical relationships between pages
  • Improve the distribution of internal link authority
  • Reduce the number of isolated or orphaned pages

Internal Link Network Graph

The internal-link graph provides a visual representation of how supported content is connected.

It can help you identify:

  • Orphaned pages
  • Pages with few or no incoming links
  • Highly connected pages
  • Missing relationships between related content
  • New internal-linking opportunities

Meta Tags and Structured Data

SeoVia can generate and manage important SEO metadata, including:

  • SEO titles
  • Meta descriptions
  • Canonical URLs
  • Robots directives
  • Open Graph metadata
  • Social-sharing metadata

It can also generate JSON-LD structured data for supported content types, including examples such as:

  • Article
  • BlogPosting
  • Product
  • FAQ
  • Breadcrumbs

When Yoast SEO or Rank Math is active, SeoVia can integrate with the existing environment. For values explicitly applied through SeoVia, SeoVia’s output may take precedence over corresponding values from another SEO plugin.

AI-Generated Featured and In-Content Images

SeoVia can generate visual content related to the subject of an article.

Depending on the selected operation and service configuration, it may generate:

  • A featured image
  • Multiple relevant in-content images

This can reduce the time needed to prepare visual assets and help create more complete articles.

Category and Tag Management

SeoVia evaluates the categories and tags associated with supported content and may recommend adding or removing relationships.

This can help improve:

  • Content organization
  • Website structure
  • Topical consistency
  • Navigation between related subjects

AI SEO Assistant

The SeoVia Assistant provides a conversational interface for SEO-related tasks.

It can interpret natural-language requests, answer questions about supported SEO workflows, analyze website content, and help manage recommendations without requiring you to navigate through every section manually.

Available capabilities depend on the connected SeoVia account, enabled features, and selected AI model.

AI Post Creator

The AI Post Creator guides you through creating new content using a structured workflow.

The process may include:

  1. Entering a target keyword or topic
  2. Reviewing suggested article ideas
  3. Selecting or refining an idea
  4. Generating the article
  5. Preparing metadata and structured data
  6. Adding internal links
  7. Generating relevant images
  8. Reviewing the final result before publication

This can help cover content gaps and create new search-focused content more efficiently.

Google Search Console Integration

SeoVia can connect to Google Search Console through the SeoVia service.

Depending on the permissions granted and the available Google data, the integration can provide information related to:

  • Search performance
  • Clicks and impressions
  • Click-through rate
  • Average search position
  • URL inspection
  • Indexing status
  • Keyword opportunities
  • Content gaps
  • Index coverage

This allows SEO decisions to be based on actual search-performance data instead of estimates alone.

AI Impact Measurement

The AI Impact feature compares supported performance metrics before and after SeoVia recommendations are applied.

Metrics may include:

  • Clicks
  • Impressions
  • Click-through rate
  • Average search position

This helps evaluate whether applied changes are associated with improved organic-search performance over time.

Search performance can be influenced by many external factors, so reported changes should not be interpreted as a guarantee that SeoVia alone caused a specific ranking or traffic result.

Keyword Opportunities and Content Gaps

SeoVia can evaluate available Search Console and website data to identify potential opportunities, including:

  • Queries close to higher-ranking positions
  • Pages with relatively low click-through rates
  • Queries with positive growth
  • Topics with potential search demand
  • Relevant subjects not yet covered by existing content

These opportunities can then be reviewed and prioritized according to your content strategy.

XML Sitemap Management

SeoVia can generate and maintain an XML sitemap for supported website content.

It can help search engines discover new and updated pages and may support submitting sitemap information through connected Google services.

Multiple AI Models and Providers

SeoVia supports more than 30 AI models from providers including:

  • OpenAI
  • Anthropic Claude
  • Google Gemini
  • DeepSeek
  • Stability AI

Available providers and models may change over time and may depend on your SeoVia account, plan, regional availability, and service configuration.

The multi-provider architecture allows users to select different models for supported tasks and provides alternatives when a particular provider is unavailable.

Transparent Credit Usage

Before supported AI operations are started, SeoVia displays the estimated credit requirement.

This helps users understand the expected service-credit usage before confirming an operation.

Credit requirements may vary depending on the selected model, provider, operation, content length, and service pricing.

Live Content Preview

Before applying supported recommendations, SeoVia can display a preview of the proposed result.

Preview tools may include:

  • Content previews
  • Before-and-after comparisons
  • Search-result previews
  • Metadata previews

This helps users review generated changes before applying them.

Account and External Service Requirement

SeoVia is a WordPress client for the external SeoVia software-as-a-service platform.

A SeoVia account is required to use AI analysis, content generation, image generation, Google Search Console integration, and other service-based features.

Some service features may require a paid plan or the purchase of service credits.

The WordPress plugin code distributed through WordPress.org is open source. However, AI processing and other service-based operations are performed by the external SeoVia service.

The plugin does not send website content to SeoVia before an account has been connected and the required consent has been provided.

External Services

This plugin connects to the SeoVia service to provide its primary functionality.

Service website:

https://seovia.ai

SeoVia API:

https://seovia.ai/api

SeoVia web application:

https://seovia.ai/app

Data Sent to SeoVia

Depending on the operation requested, the plugin may send the following data to the SeoVia service:

  • Post, page, or product title
  • Main content
  • Excerpt
  • URL
  • WordPress content ID
  • Content type and status
  • Featured-image information
  • Categories and tags
  • SEO metadata
  • Selected plugin settings
  • Data required to perform a requested analysis or generation operation
  • The SeoVia API key used to authenticate the connected account

Data may be sent when:

  • You manually request an analysis
  • You request AI-generated content or images
  • You apply supported recommendations
  • You use the SeoVia Assistant
  • You save supported content after enabling connected synchronization features
  • A configured SeoVia workflow requires updated content data

No website content is sent until a SeoVia account has been connected and the relevant consent has been provided during onboarding.

Data Written Back to WordPress

The SeoVia service may send generated results back to the WordPress website, including:

  • Recommended or generated content
  • Meta tags
  • Structured data
  • Internal links
  • Categories and tags
  • Generated-image information
  • Recommendation statuses

Backend-to-site requests are verified by the plugin using signed requests. The SeoVia service does not require or receive your WordPress administrator password.

Google Search Console Data

When Google Search Console is connected, relevant Search Console information is processed through the SeoVia service.

This may include:

  • Search queries
  • Landing-page performance
  • Clicks
  • Impressions
  • Click-through rate
  • Average search position
  • URL inspection information
  • Indexing and coverage information

Google Search Console is connected only after the user initiates and authorizes the connection.

Service Terms and Privacy

Use of the external SeoVia service is governed by the following documents:

Terms of Service:

https://seovia.ai/terms

Privacy Policy:

https://seovia.ai/privacy

You should review these documents before connecting a SeoVia account or using service-based features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the SeoVia plugin through the WordPress plugin installer, or install it directly from the WordPress.org Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate SeoVia from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open SeoVia from the WordPress administration menu.
  4. Create or connect a SeoVia account.
  5. Review the requested permissions and data-processing information.
  6. Complete the onboarding process.
  7. Start analyzing supported WordPress content.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

The WordPress plugin distributed through WordPress.org is open source and can be installed without charge.

Some external SeoVia service features may require credits, a paid plan, or both. Required credits are displayed before supported AI operations are confirmed. also there is 1,000 credits as a gift when you install the plugin for the first time.

Does the plugin send my content to an external server?

Yes, but only after you connect a SeoVia account and provide the required consent.

Content and metadata needed for the operation may then be sent to the SeoVia service for analysis, generation, synchronization, or other requested functionality.

See the External Services section for details.

Is my WordPress password shared with SeoVia?

No.

The SeoVia service does not require or receive your WordPress administrator password.

Requests sent from the service back to the website are authenticated using a signed-request mechanism verified by the plugin.

Does SeoVia work with WooCommerce?

Yes. SeoVia can analyze and optimize supported WooCommerce products, including product content, metadata, structured data, images, categories, and internal links.

WooCommerce must be installed and active to use WooCommerce-specific functionality.

Does SeoVia work with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

SeoVia can operate alongside Yoast SEO and Rank Math.

When a value has been explicitly generated and applied through SeoVia, SeoVia may output its own version of that metadata or structured data. In those cases, the SeoVia value may take precedence.

Before using multiple SEO plugins together, review the generated page source and disable overlapping features when necessary to avoid duplicate metadata or structured data.

Can I undo changes made by SeoVia?

Supported content changes can be reverted when SeoVia has stored the previous version required for restoration.

Availability depends on the recommendation type and operation.

Does SeoVia guarantee higher rankings?

No.

SeoVia provides analysis, automation, content-generation tools, and recommendations intended to support SEO work. Search rankings depend on many factors controlled by search engines and other third parties.

No SEO plugin or service can guarantee a particular ranking, traffic increase, indexing result, or search position.

Can I change the AI model?

Yes, where supported.

Available models depend on the SeoVia service configuration, your account, your plan, regional availability, and the operation being performed.

Which languages are supported?

AI-generated content supports additional languages depending on the selected provider and model, even though the plugin interface is in English only, but depending on the model, it will follow your wordpress and existing content language for the suggestions.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • Migrations: creating a plan is now a guided, step-by-step wizard instead of a row of buttons, and the plans list shows how far each plan has got.
  • Migrations: added a drift check that reports how many URLs have actually moved before any redirects are built.
  • Internal Links: past rewrites are now kept as a history, showing what changed, how many posts matched and how many links were updated.
  • Fixed redirects never matching URLs that contain non-Latin characters, such as Persian or Arabic slugs.
  • Fixed the generated Apache and nginx rules using percent-encoded paths that the web server could never match.
  • An unreachable destination no longer blocks a plan from being activated; it is now reported as a warning, because a failed fetch does not prove the destination is bad.
  • Redirect verification now separates “could not be reached” from “failed”, instead of reporting both as failures.
  • Fixed Capture URLs overwriting the snapshot it depends on.
  • Refreshed the logo and colour scheme.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

0.2.0

  • Added bulk post creation, so several articles can be generated from one run.
  • Added a General Settings option to insert internal links as plain URLs instead of the [seovia_link] shortcode.
  • Internal link suggestions are now spread across different sections of the content.
  • Added category and tag filters to the content lists.
  • Improved the block editor sidebar and fixed Search Console page-distribution figures.

0.1.0

  • Initial public release.
